__setup_notes__.openai: Requires OpenAI credential in n8n. Uses gpt-4o-mini for cost-efficiency. Switch to gpt-4o for higher quality.
__setup_notes__.intent_detection: Rule-based. Triggers Telegram alert for booking/human/quote intents. 'suggestForm' and 'suggestCall' flags returned to frontend — chat widget uses these to show CTA buttons.
__setup_notes__.response_shape: { message: string, intent: string, suggestForm: boolean, suggestCall: boolean }
__setup_notes__.system_prompt: Embedded in 'Extract Chat Payload' node — edit the systemPrompt variable to update bot personality.
__setup_notes__.telegram: Set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in n8n env. Alerts only fire for high-intent messages (booking/human/quote), not every message.
__setup_notes__.credentials: Replace 'openai-cred' and 'telegram-cred' IDs with your actual n8n credential IDs.
